prose.subject: URGENT: Updated NEAR Payout Details for INV-22163
prose.body:
Hi Ines,

I hope your week is going well. I’m reaching out because we’ve recently migrated our treasury operations to a new cold wallet structure to improve security and streamline settlement times.

As a result, our payout address for USDC transfers has changed effective immediately. Please ensure that the outstanding balance for Invoice INV-22163 (5,400.95 USDC) is directed to our new dedicated vendor account: fennicsupply85.testnet

To avoid any processing delays or auto-reversals due to our updated compliance checks, we kindly request that this transfer is initiated by close of business today. If you have already queued the payment against our old address, please cancel it and reissue to the new account above.

I’ve attached the updated invoice confirmation for your records. If you have any questions or need the verification checksum, let me know and I’ll have our finance lead send it over right away.

Thanks for your prompt attention to this, Ines. Looking forward to our continued partnership.

Best regards,

Hana Adeyemi
Accounts Receivable Manager
Fennick Supply
